column3: New version of gen_y.py 81976a96b4d3 holding only its emitter of proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB1v.v (yb1v(), lines 62-87 of the full script, verbatim, with the module path constants), the four window values (constants in the full script) as arguments. The full script does not run: its other emitters read a listing that is not kept (not re-derivable: input lost); YB1v reads none of it. run.sh re-derives proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB1v.v byte for byte.

The re-run of proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB1v.v: gen_y.py with the four values of record (musl window start 0x8f6b0 and 16102 slots, exit-guard window start 0x80f44 and 4 instructions), which were read by hand from the image's symbols and sections; cmp with proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB1v.v: equal. The windows' instruction decode is kernel-checked in YB1v.v itself (tfibmusl_tbl_eq by vm_cast_no_check, tfibmusl_tbl_ok). It then derives the four values by rule with derive_yb1v.py (with TWIN_B, after making the symbol extract again) and fails unless they equal the values of record: they do.

Check script: the four YB1v window values by rule from the image's .text and two named symbols: the address of sysconf (the first musl function; the name is given by hand), (end of .text - that) // 4 (the full script's formula), the address of oft_exit_guard, and its 4-byte instructions through the first ret. On the image B pin and the twin's symbols it prints 0x8f6b0 16102 0x80f44 4, the values of record.

Extract script: writes named function symbols of image B's unstripped twin as nm text (here sysconf and oft_exit_guard), with a header naming the twin's and the pin's sha256 and that PT_LOAD 2..4 of twin and pin are byte-equal (checked; it refuses otherwise). Same bytes as ycej/extract_syms.py.
extract_syms.py output on image B's twin and pin for the symbols sysconf (0x8f6b0) and oft_exit_guard (0x80f44); derive_yb1v.py reads it. run.sh with TWIN_B makes it again and compares.
